content:
**1) LAYOUT**
*   **Window:** 1024x768 (Maximized, standard Windows 11 chrome).
*   **Title Bar (0-40px):** App icon + Title (left), "Buy Now" CTA + Action icons (right).
*   **Toolbar/Address Bar (40-115px):** Navigation cluster (Home, Back, Forward, Up), Breadcrumb ("Windows (C:)"), View toggles, Filter button, Search bar.
*   **Main Content Area (115-815px):** Three-pane layout.
    *   **Left Pane (Tree View):** ~280px wide. Contains "Path"/"Type" tabs and a hierarchical list of scan locations.
    *   **Center Pane (File List):** Flexible width. Header row with "Name", "Date Modified", "Type". List view with checkboxes.
    *   **Right Pane (Preview/Details):** ~240px wide. Shows icon, name, "Open" button, and metadata (Size, Date, Path). Floating AI assistant orb in bottom-right corner.
*   **Status Bar / Scanning Strip (815-875px):** Full-width blue band. Left: Progress gauge + Stats. Right: Timer icon + "Recover All ..." button.
*   **Taskbar (875-1000px):** Windows 11 centered taskbar.

**2) TEXT (Verbatim)**
*   **Title Bar:** `EaseUS Data Recovery Wizard Free`
*   **Button (Top Right):** `Buy Now`
*   **Breadcrumb:** `Windows (C:)`
*   **Filter/Search:** `Filter`, `Search files or folders`
*   **Tabs (Left):** `Path`, `Type`
*   **Tree Items:**
    *   `Windows (C:)` | `1.1M`
    *   `File Path Lost` | `4.3K`
    *   `Reconstructed` | `6`
*   **List Headers:** `Name`, `Date Modified`, `Type`
*   **List Items (Sample):**
    *   `actionarchivecache` | `10/7/2026 11:30 PM` | `File folder`
    *   `actions-runner` | `10/17/2026 6:11 PM` | `File folder`
    *   `azureCli` | `10/8/2026 1:50 AM` | `File folder`
    *   `cobertura-2.1.1` | `2/26/2015 11:23 PM` | `File folder`
    *   `ghcup` | `10/8/2026 12:32 AM` | `File folder`
    *   `hostedtoolcache` | `10/7/2026 11:25 PM` | `File folder`
    *   `image` | `10/7/2026 9:08 PM` | `File folder`
    *   `inetpub` | `10/7/2026 10:10 PM` | `File folder`
    *   `Julia` | `10/7/2026 11:21 PM` | `File folder`
    *   `mingw32` | `2/19/2026 12:59 PM` | `File folder`
*   **Right Pane:**
    *   `actionarchivecache`
    *   `Open`
    *   `Size` | `7.29 MB`
    *   `Date Modified` | `10/7/2026 11:30 PM`
    *   `Path` | `C:\`
*   **Status Strip (Blue):**
    *   `Searching: ...\\003000000A9F90197D9D80\Microsoft.CodeAnalysis.CSharp.resources.dll`
    *   `21%`
    *   `Advanced Scanning , Files Found: 1139163 (146.29 GB)`
    *   `Remaining time: 10m24s`
    *   `Reading sector: 62070784/313413598`
    *   `Recover All ...`

**3) COLOR (Estimated Hex)**
*   **Backgrounds:**
    *   Window/App BG: `#F5F9FF` (Very light blue-grey)
    *   List Item Selected: `#D6E8FF` (Light blue)
    *   Status Strip BG: `#E3F2FD` (Light blue) with a darker blue progress bar overlay/text line.
    *   Tree/List Header BG: `#F0F4F8`
    *   Right Pane BG: `#FFFFFF` (White)
*   **Text:**
    *   Primary Text: `#1F1F1F` (Near Black)
    *   Secondary Text/Metadata: `#666666` or `#555555`
    *   Link/Accent Text (Path tab): `#1677FF` (Blue)
*   **Accents/Controls:**
    *   Primary Button (Recover All): `#1677FF` (Blue)
    *   Primary Button (Open): `#BDD4FF` (Light Blue bg) / `#1677FF` text
    *   Buy Now Button: `#FFA940` (Orange/Yellow)
    *   Progress Ring: `#1677FF` (Blue fill), `#E8E8E8` (Track)

**4) TYPOGRAPHY**
*   **Font Family:** Segoe UI (Standard Windows).
*   **Sizes:**
    *   Title Bar: 12px Regular
    *   Tree/List Items: 13px Regular
    *   Headers (Name, Date...): 12px Semi-bold
    *   Status Strip Main Text: 13px Bold (`Advanced Scanning...`)
    *   Status Strip Sub-text: 11px Regular (`Searching...`, `Remaining time...`)
    *   Percentage (Gauge): 14px Bold

**5) SPACING & SIZING**
*   **Row Height (List):** ~36px - 40px.
*   **Icon Size (List/Tree):** 16x16px.
*   **Progress Gauge Diameter:** ~50px - 56px.
*   **Padding:**
    *   List Item Left Padding: ~10px (after checkbox).
    *   Pane Gaps: ~2px - 4px (divider width).
    *   Status Strip Padding: ~8px vertical, ~10px horizontal.
*   **Border Radius:**
    *   Buttons: 4px - 6px.
    *   Search Bar: 4px.
    *   Tabs (Path/Type): 4px (top corners).

**6) CONTROLS & STATES**
*   **Buttons:**
    *   `Buy Now`: Normal state, solid background.
    *   `Filter`: Normal, icon + text.
    *   `Open` (Right pane): Normal, light background.
    *   `Recover All ...`: Normal, primary solid blue.
*   **Input:**
    *   `Search files or folders`: Placeholder text visible, search icon right-aligned.
*   **Selection:**
    *   `Path` Tab: Active (Blue text, white bg implied or distinct styling).
    *   List Row 1 (`actionarchivecache`): Selected state (Blue highlight).
    *   Checkboxes: Unchecked (square outline).
*   **Tree View:**
    *   Expand/Collapse arrows (chevrons) visible next to parent items.

**7) ICONOGRAPHY**
*   **Style:** Fluent Design / Windows 11 style (Outline and Filled mixed).
*   **Specifics:**
    *   Navigation: Home (house), Back, Forward, Up arrow.
    *   View: List view (active), Filter funnel.
    *   File Type: Generic Folder icon (blue/yellow depending on context, here mostly blue for system folders).
    *   Actions: Search (magnifying glass), Menu (hamburger), Minimize/Maximize/Close.
    *   Status: Clock/History icon (next to Recover button).
    *   AI Assistant: Circular icon with sparkle/magic wand motif in bottom right of content area.

**8) STATE**
*   **Page State:** **Active Scanning (Partial Success)**. The application is currently performing an "Advanced Scanning" operation. It is not idle, nor is it finished. It has found data (1.1M+ files) but the process is ongoing (21% complete).
*   **Motion Cues:**
    *   The circular progress gauge implies rotation (standard for this UI pattern).
    *   The status text `Searching: ...` implies real-time updating of the file path string.
    *   The progress bar underlying the blue strip (or the strip itself acting as a progress container) indicates progression.
